rounds.text: Manugraph India Ltd is currently trading at a significant discount to its intrinsic value, evidenced by a price-to-book ratio of 0.49x [E1] and a P/E ratio of 5.89x, which is substantially lower than the sector benchmark of 23.97x [E5]. The company has demonstrated a dramatic operational turnaround, evidenced by a 73% compounded sales growth over the trailing twelve months [E16] and a year-over-year sales increase of 180% [E63]. This momentum is further supported by consistent quarter-over-quarter sales growth [E66], which significantly outperforms the sector median sales growth of 18.3% [E73]. While the company maintains a positive ROE of 4.86% [E8], it is conceded that the ROA is -9.42% [E7] and long-term compounded sales growth over the past decade remains negative [E13]. Furthermore, it is conceded that the dividend yield is 0.00% [E3] and earnings growth is currently decelerating [E67]. Despite these historical headwinds, the current valuation metrics suggest the market has yet to fully price in the recent, robust acceleration in sales performance [E64].
